Headline: Forest Park-bound Blue Line Service Delayed at Clark/Lake
ShortDescription: UPDATE: Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Clark/Lake due to a sick passenger. Crews working to restore service.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
Forest Park-bound Blue Line trains are standing at Clark/Lake due to a sick passenger.

Consider other service alternatives that may serve your trip, such as nearby bus routes or using buses to other rail lines.

These may include:
#22 Clark

Bus shuttles have been requested from Damen to LaSalle, in both directions to provide service through the affected area. 


Personnel are working to restore service. Allow extra travel time.
